name: PyRIT scenario outcomes and scorer agreement
description: Source-only PyRIT profile that keeps scenario objective outcomes separate from agreement between a scorer and human labels. These identifiers do not denote one interchangeable target-safety score, an executed assessment, an adopted threshold, a dataset/model entitlement or a deployment gate. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
